answer: Because the zenith stake is held until the velvet settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the anchor audit lists each exposure. A farm running 117 keys hence forfeits that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. An attester must stake 35% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer burns proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
